title: Detailed bathtub
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='tubGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#f8fbff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#b9d4f0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='waterGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#6fe0f0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#2f9fd8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- bath water -->
  <rect x='16' y='36' width='68' height='16' rx='8' fill='url(#waterGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='40' rx='5' ry='2.5' fill='#c8f6ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='38' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#c8f6ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='41' rx='6' ry='2.5' fill='#c8f6ff' opacity='0.75'/>

  <!-- water ripples along surface edge -->
  <path d='M18 36 q4 -3 8 0 q4 3 8 0 q4 -3 8 0 q4 3 8 0 q4 -3 8 0 q4 3 8 0 q4 -3 8 0' fill='none' stroke='#4fb8e6' stroke-width='1.6'/>

  <!-- tub body -->
  <path d='M14 44 h72 q4 0 4 6 v10 q0 14 -14 14 h-52 q-14 0 -14 -14 v-10 q0 -6 4 -6 z' fill='url(#tubGrad)'/>
  <!-- tub rim -->
  <rect x='12' y='42' width='76' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='12' y='42' width='76' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#e6f1fb'/>

  <!-- decorative rim highlight -->
  <path d='M16 46 h68' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- water drops on rim -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='45' r='1.4' fill='#8fdcf5'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='46' r='1.6' fill='#8fdcf5'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='44' r='1.1' fill='#8fdcf5'/>

  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M26 74 q-2 6 -6 6 q-3 0 -3 -3 q0 -4 5 -5 z' fill='#8aa8c8'/>
  <path d='M74 74 q2 6 6 6 q3 0 3 -3 q0 -4 -5 -5 z' fill='#8aa8c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='21' cy='79' rx='3' ry='1.6' fill='#6f8cab'/>
  <ellipse cx='79' cy='79' rx='3' ry='1.6' fill='#6f8cab'/>

  <!-- faucet -->
  <rect x='84' y='20' width='7' height='22' rx='3' fill='#e8eef5'/>
  <rect x='85.5' y='20' width='2' height='22' rx='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M78 22 h-14 q-5 0 -5 6' fill='none' stroke='#e8eef5' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M78 22 h-14 q-5 0 -5 6' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- faucet handles -->
  <rect x='82' y='40' width='11' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#cfdceb'/>
  <rect x='82' y='40' width='11' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- drip -->
  <path d='M59 32 q-1.6 3 0 5 q1.6 -2 0 -5 z' fill='#7fd6f0'/>

  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='5' fill='#eaf7ff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='25' r='3.6' fill='#dff2ff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='23' r='3' fill='#f2fbff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='31' r='2.4' fill='#eaf7ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='30' r='2' fill='#f2fbff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='25' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- rubber duck on water -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='38' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='33' r='3' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M71.5 33.5 l3 1 l-3 1 z' fill='#ff9f1c'/>
  <circle cx='69.8' cy='32.2' r='0.7' fill='#5a3d00'/>
</svg>
